summary: Pro installs now come straight from Invardia, signed and checked, and several install problems are fixed.

new.title: Pro installs come from Invardia
new.text: The Pro install line from invardia.com now gets the signed and checked Pro package from Invardia, and you sign in once. The Community edition still installs from GitHub.

fixes.title: Install fixes from recent versions
fixes.text: A Pro install without a licence starts, a new subscription's quota no longer stops it, a second run in one window signs in again, and the installer gets data access.
